blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police authorities intercepted an estimated P14 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes during a pre-dawn operation along the shoreline of Barangay Campo Islam, Zamboanga City, on Tuesday.
